Network Title: British Columbia – Capital Regional District, Meteorological Network

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface

Network Provider: Capital Regional District

Network Provider Website: https://www.crd.bc.ca/

Station Automation: Automated

Highest Sampling Frequency: Hourly

Data Feed Frequency: Real time for 15 Atmospheric: Surface/Hydrometric stations. Manual data feed for 18 Hydrometric stations.

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations: 11 Atmospheric Surface, 22 Hydrometric

Category of Reported Elements: Temperature; Humidity; Total Precipitation; Rainfall; Wind; Soil; Radiation; Pressure; Water Quality; Water Quantity; Snow Depth; Snow Water Equivalent

Data Access Points: 
https://dd.weather.gc.ca/today/observations/swob-ml/partners/bc-crd/
https://services.pacificclimate.org/met-data-portal-pcds/app/
https://www.crd.bc.ca/about/data/fire-weather-conditions

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): No

Legal Constraints: Standard Data Use Agreement
